convert.allow-missing: Skip mods whose file can't be fetched; build the rest
convert.appended-start: Appended to the start script as-is
convert.auto-classifying: Auto-classifying · the plan lands when it's done
convert.auto-classifying-wait: Auto-classifying; wait for the plan to start
convert.cancel-anytime: You can cancel anytime; downloads are cached and reused
convert.conversion-running: A conversion is running; this task was queued
convert.detection-finished: Detection finished, confirm the plan to start the build
convert.downloads-needed: No downloads needed · all from the pack and local files
convert.enter-port: Enter a port 1-65535 in "Server settings" first
convert.estimating-wait: Download estimate once classification is done
convert.fetching-loader: Fetching loader versions; pick one to start
convert.fix-java: Fix Java in "Runtime" first; the loader can't install
convert.fix-missing: Some required mods have no fetchable file; set them to Remove in the plan, or tick Skip
convert.folder-selected: Nothing selected · click "Add content" above to pick from the pack
convert.folders-copied: These folders and files came from the source pack, each landed at the output root under its own name
convert.go-home: Go to Home to pick a modpack
convert.install-loader: Install loader locally (upload to go live)
convert.jdk-picked: · the JDK picked in the plan is no longer installed
convert.keepable-folders: Nothing keepable in the pack (no resource files outside mods)
convert.manual-edits: Manual edits cleared; plan back to auto-classified
convert.mc-list-failed: Couldn't load the Minecraft version list · {{reason}}
convert.missing-optional_one: {{count}} optional mod has no fetchable file and will be skipped
convert.missing-optional_other: {{count}} optional mods have no fetchable file and will be skipped
convert.missing-required: {{total}} mods have no fetchable file, {{required}} of them required
convert.modpack-selected: No modpack selected yet, so there is nothing to configure.
convert.name-disabled: {{name}} disabled: required server-side; dependents may fail
convert.offline-pass: Offline pass done · online lookup running
convert.online-lookup: Online lookup unfinished; remaining rows keep offline results. Tap Reclassify to retry
convert.pick-mc-version: Minecraft version not detected; pick one in "Runtime" first
convert.plan-saved: No plan saved for this task
convert.selected-folders: Whatever level you check is what lands there: folders copy whole (inner layout kept), single files copy as themselves — all at the output root
convert.server-fields-kept: You kept the pack's server.properties · these fields don't go into the pack, that file wins
convert.source-pack: Source pack missing · can't browse its content; existing entries still removable
convert.source-pack-missing: Source pack missing · this task kept no pack folders or files
convert.task-kept: This task kept no pack folders or files
convert.usable-java: No usable Java on this machine
convert.write-eula-kept: eula.txt comes from the pack · this switch doesn't reach the pack
convert.writes-server: Writes these into the pack's server.properties · checking that file there keeps its own copy
